prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is attached sky mushroom kingdom painting. Create dormant game background. Remove ONLY all three waterfall systems and the foreground flying parasol. Waterfall 1 at x43-48%,y32-50%; waterfall 2 including both thin left and broad right streams at x44-56%,y50-74%; waterfall 3 at x29-35%,y77-89%. Reconstruct the mushroom ledges and undersides, moss and cloud background underneath the water, retaining all exact shapes of the islands. No water streaks, wet streams or falling water remain. Remove the entire pink flying umbrella at lower right including its canopy, wooden handle, bow and long ribbons (x56-96%,y54-89%); restore the soft clouds and open sky behind it. Preserve every castle, bridge, mushroom, foliage, other clouds, colours and exact composition. Same 4:3 framing. No new objects.

Use case: background-extraction. Reference is the attached mushroom sky kingdom. Create ONE separate small floating cloud game sprite matching the reference painting: fluffy rounded ivory and peach-pink lit upper lobes, lavender rose underside, soft painterly contours with a delicate warm outline, sunlit pastel storybook brushwork. Wide low cloud about 2.5:1 shape, complete silhouette, centred and tightly framed with small transparent margin. Actual transparent background. No face, eyes, rain, sparkles, icons, text, mushrooms or scenery. This cloud must look like a movable piece of the painting, not a flat vector pictogram.

Use case: background-extraction. Extract ONLY the full pink flying mushroom parasol from the lower-right foreground of the reference painting. Preserve its exact orientation, pink cap with cream spots, softly lit peach underside with radiating ribs, curved wooden handle, tied bow and BOTH long ribbons stretching left. Single complete game sprite on actual transparent background. Tight framing with small margin, no clipping. Remove all clouds, scenery and any cast ground shadow. Match the exact painted style; no redesign, text or new objects.
